statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit across six representative paths. No source was supplied, so this is critique only.

page.notes: Public Spanish media catalogue with an age-entry gate, listing/search/detail templates, and account forms. Not covered: authenticated feeds, uploads, payments/premium checkout, playback beyond initial player state, or destructive account actions because they require credentials, purchases, or content changes.

paths.description: Homepage and primary discovery listing; represents the main content template and age-entry state.
Best-content listing; represents alternate index/listing pages sharing the card grid.
Search results reached through the homepage search form; represents the primary find-content flow.
Representative video detail/player page; covers media, metadata, captions, and content-consumption UI.
Sign-in/sign-up/recovery surface; covers forms, authentication, error handling, and input assistance.
Deliberately invalid route; represents HTTP/error recovery.

findings.summary: The interface does not honor the user’s dark-theme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot is visually unchanged from the default capture, and the CSS probe found no prefers-color-scheme, color-scheme, or light-dark() use.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and map surfaces/text to preference-aware color tokens, following dark-mode guidance.

findings.summary: Reduced-motion preferences are not handled explicitly.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no prefers-reduced-motion rule. The listing currently had no active animations, but player and navigation effects have no preference-aware safeguard.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce layer that disables non-essential transitions, smooth scrolling, and auto-advance.

findings.summary: High-contrast preferences are not explicitly supported.
findings.evidence: The prefers-contrast capture retains the default styling, while the CSS probe found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors handling.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast adaptations for controls, borders, icons, and focus indicators.

findings.summary: Route changes use abrupt full-document swaps.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found no View Transition CSS, and navigation among listing, search, account, and detail pages performs ordinary visual swaps.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance same-origin navigation with cross-document View Transitions and a no-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Page chrome does not respond to scroll state.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no scroll-state queries or scroll-position-aware styling on long listing pages.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll-state-aware CSS for sticky navigation or a compact header where that improves orientation.

findings.summary: Navigation does not visually guide attention after a route or in-page state change.
findings.evidence: The search and listing captures show static page swaps; the probe found no directional transition or highlight mechanism.
findings.suggestedFix: Use directional transitions or a focused/highlighted destination state so users can follow navigation changes.

findings.summary: The age-entry overlay is implemented without a semantic dialog primitive.
findings.evidence: The load screenshot shows a blocking age-entry overlay, but the DOM probe found zero dialog, popover, details, or aria-modal elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement the age gate as a real dialog with an accessible name, trapped initial focus, and explicit completion behavior.

findings.summary: Reusable listing components are responsive only at page level.
findings.evidence: Mobile layout has no overflow, but CSS inspection found no container queries or container-type on reused card/search components.
findings.suggestedFix: Use container queries where cards or controls appear in differently sized regions, retaining viewport fallbacks.

findings.summary: Zoom is disabled and many interactive targets are too small.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found user-scalable=no/maximum-scale=1, and the probe counted 106 visible interactive elements below 24px in at least one dimension.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale restrictions; enlarge controls to accessible target sizes and preserve visible focus.

findings.summary: Mobile loading misses the good LCP range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 5.1s and performance 0.74, while the trace’s warmer desktop-like run measured LCP 1.60s, showing a material condition-dependent gap.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP candidate, reduce initial image/script competition, and verify mobile LCP under repeatable throttling.

findings.summary: The mobile listing shifts substantially during load.
findings.evidence: The mobile layout observer measured CLS 0.272 across six shifts; 99 of 100 images lack width/height attributes.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve intrinsic image space with width/height or aspect-ratio and stabilize late banners/content.

findings.summary: Critical delivery includes parser-blocking scripts and weak image caching.
findings.evidence: HAR/DOM confirmation found a head parser script without async/defer plus additional parser scripts, and the HAR summary lists multiple images without cache headers.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-critical scripts, shorten the critical chain, and give immutable thumbnails effective cache headers.

findings.summary: The homepage ships substantial unused code.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated about 594KB unused JavaScript and 211KB unused CSS on the audited load.
findings.suggestedFix: Split page-specific code and styles, remove duplicate jQuery delivery, and conditionally load player/account dependencies.

findings.summary: Many controls and images lack accessible names or alternatives.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed button-name, link-name, and image-alt; the image primitive found 98 of 100 images without alt text.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every control a discernible name and each meaningful thumbnail an appropriate alt; use empty alt only for decorative images.

findings.summary: Text and UI contrast fail WCAG minimums.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse’s color-contrast audit failed on both homepage and account surfaces.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to meet WCAG AA, including subdued metadata and form states.

findings.summary: Pages lack a logical heading and main-landmark structure.
findings.evidence: The homepage probe found no headings and no main element; Lighthouse also failed the account page for lacking one main landmark.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one descriptive h1 per page template, logical subordinate headings, and a main landmark around primary content.

findings.summary: Core text is rendered too small and densely for comfortable reading.
findings.evidence: Computed body text is 12px across homepage/account DOM captures, and the mobile screenshots show dense metadata and legal text.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase base and metadata sizing with fluid type, adequate line height, and more forgiving wrapping.

findings.summary: User zoom is prevented.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse recorded a viewport meta value with maximum-scale=1 and user-scalable=no. The media detail also exposed no caption track in the sampled video.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow pinch zoom and ensure media templates expose captions or an equivalent when captions exist.

findings.summary: The account page logs identity-provider errors.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured a Google FedCM NetworkError and a “Not signed in with the identity provider” console message during account load.
findings.suggestedFix: Treat expected signed-out FedCM outcomes without console errors and log only actionable failures.

findings.summary: Document assets omit sizing and use a deprecated media-control selector.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 99 images without dimensions; Lighthouse reported the deprecated internal cast-button selector.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic image dimensions and replace the internal selector with disableRemotePlayback where appropriate.

findings.summary: Browser-development hygiene is incomplete.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found missing/404 source maps for large first-party, HLS, and verification scripts, plus a deprecated API warning.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish valid production source maps to controlled endpoints and remove deprecated browser integration hooks.

findings.summary: The account template has no meta description.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse SEO scored the account page 0.92 but specifically failed meta-description; homepage and detail titles were descriptive.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a concise, unique description for public account and other indexable templates, or explicitly noindex pages not intended for search.

findings.summary: Some links are not crawlable or have no discernible text.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed crawlable-anchors; the DOM probe counted four href anchors with empty names and one anchor without href.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href URLs for navigation and descriptive visible or accessible link text.

findings.summary: Canonical signals are absent on sampled public templates.
findings.evidence: Homepage and detail metadata probes found hreflang alternates but no rel=canonical URL.
findings.suggestedFix: Add self-referential canonical links that agree with hreflang, sitemap, and preferred clean URLs.

findings.summary: Transport defenses are incomplete and CSP permits unsafe script execution.
findings.evidence: Headers show HTTPS and CSP, but no HSTS or nosniff; CSP allows unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy HSTS and nosniff, then migrate inline/eval code to nonces or hashes and tighten CSP origins.

findings.summary: Authentication is password-only on the sampled account surface.
findings.evidence: The account DOM exposes email/password forms with no WebAuthn/passkey UI or source marker; no permission prompt appeared on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration and authentication alongside recovery-safe fallback methods, requesting permissions only in context.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policies are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers lack Permissions-Policy and HSTS, use no-referrer-when-downgrade, and rely on X-Frame-Options without a CSP frame-ancestors directive.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a restrictive Permissions-Policy, strict-origin-when-cross-origin or stricter referrer policy, HSTS, and CSP frame-ancestors.

findings.summary: The installed-app/offline story is incomplete and locale-inconsistent.
findings.evidence: A manifest exists, but no service-worker registration was found and its start_url points to xvideos.com rather than the audited .es locale.
findings.suggestedFix: Register a scoped service worker with an offline fallback and set a same-origin localized start_url.

findings.summary: Form errors are not localized or announced accessibly.
findings.evidence: Submitting empty Spanish sign-in fields yields English native messages, no aria-invalid, and zero aria-live/alert regions, although focus moves to the first invalid field.
findings.suggestedFix: Use localized post-interaction validation, mark invalid controls, and announce a concise error summary.

findings.summary: Sign-in and sign-up inputs omit autocomplete tokens.
findings.evidence: Email, username, and current-password fields on the account page have empty autocomplete values; only new-password is declared.
findings.suggestedFix: Add username/email, current-password, new-password, and other correct autocomplete tokens.

findings.summary: Account flows do not offer phishing-resistant authentication.
findings.evidence: The account path offers password sign-in/recovery only; marketing is opt-in and terms are visible, but no passkey management or reauthentication surface was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkeys and clear reauthentication/account-management controls while preserving honest opt-in defaults.

findings.summary: Thumbnail delivery is not responsive or format-efficient.
findings.evidence: All 100 images lack srcset, 99 use legacy formats, and 90 below-fold images are not lazy-loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve AVIF/WebP responsive sources with srcset/sizes, dimensions, and native lazy loading below the fold.

findings.summary: The initial media/listing budget is disproportionate.
findings.evidence: HAR captured 121 requests and 2.79MB transferred before video playback, including 106 images/1.69MB and 90 below-fold images loaded eagerly.
findings.suggestedFix: Virtualize or paginate listings, lazy-load offscreen thumbnails, and enforce per-template third-party/media budgets.

taskList.title: Reserve image space and modernize thumbnail delivery
Improve mobile LCP and remove unused/render-blocking code
Add passkeys and complete account input assistance
Add preference-aware themes and contrast/motion handling
Use semantic and guided navigation primitives
Complete offline/installable behavior and browser hygiene
